calls.title: PostNord and GrowthBook
calls.summary: Postnord has fully adopted GrowthBook and plans to scale its usage from 27 to about 100 active users, targeting teams currently using other tools like Firebase for A/B testing. The primary use cases involve feature flagging and experimentation on UI elements for apps, focusing on enabling non-technical users to create experiments. Single Sign-On (SSO) is identified as a critical enterprise requirement for secure user management across 40,000 employees. Additionally, GrowthBook's enterprise features, such as visual A/B editors and multi-armed bandits, are seen as essential for improving experimentation capabilities. Competitive pricing is expected, with a follow-up meeting planned to finalize terms and engage key stakeholders post-PI planning.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, PostNord, feature flagging, enterprise edition, single sign-on, experimentation

calls.title: PostNord & Growthbook Proposal
calls.summary: The discussion explored the complex decision-making structure at PostNord concerning the adoption of Growthbook, highlighting the roles of the Customer Solutions and Production Divisions. Currently, 27 Growthbook seats are in use, with plans to scale to over 100, particularly focusing on onboarding flow experiments. Pricing concerns arose regarding the proposed Enterprise license at $200,000 annually, which is perceived as expensive compared to the existing self-hosted version. A one-month proof of concept is proposed to showcase Growthbook’s ROI related to key performance indicators. Additionally, technical requirements such as SSO integration and advanced experimental features, like sticky bucketing, are crucial for any potential deployment.
calls.keywords: Growthbook, PostNord, Experimentation, Onboarding, Procurement, ROI
